messages:
alexa: Heads up — supplier sent an amended manifest. They split our June reserved shipment and moved ~240 units into a late-July window.
ben: Yikes. Which reservation IDs are impacted and what's the new ETA?
orion-bot: Manifest update: reservations [RC-9024, RC-9025, RC-9026] originally 2026-06-10. New schedule: mini-tranche (120 units) -> 2026-06-22, main-tranche (240 units) -> 2026-07-26. Carrier note: "port congestion" cited.
cara: Which customers are on RC-9024/5? We have at least one launch with a hard date in mid-June.
ben: Quick map: RC-9024 -> PulseLedger (120 GPUs, launch 2026-06-18); RC-9025 -> internal buffer 100 GPUs; RC-9026 -> SIS pilot partners 140 GPUs. Total 360 reserved across the three.
linh: That June 22 mini-tranche still misses PulseLedger's 6/18 demo. We need a short-term fill.
sam: I'll open an escalation with the channel rep. Any flexibility on early release or airfreight?
alexa: Escalate and request written commitment. Also start contingency planning — ops, legal, and customer comms.
marta: Legal: don't promise credits or make admission of fault in comms. We can say "we're responding with mitigations and will provide remedies per the SLA."
linh: Infra options: (1) cross-region reassign eu-central 70 GPUs (adds 18h ops/data sync), (2) marketplace burst 100 GPUs for 7 days (cost ~2.5x), (3) slide lower-priority partner pilot to July and use their quota.
cara: PulseLedger is strategic. We should keep them whole. Option 3 hurts partner pipeline. Option 2 expensive. Option 1 is doable if legal & security signoff for cross-region data flows.
ben: We have 60 GPUs attached to a staging cluster that can be freed in 12h. Internal reserve shows 40 more idle in APAC — but moving across regions is non-trivial.
sam: Orion reply: "We can release up to 80 units early if we can accept mixed-SKU and a different firmware batch. Airfreight possible for +120 units at surcharge; need confirmation by EOD."
linh: Mixed-SKU swaps mean compatibility testing — adds ~6h of validation per batch. Ops can do fast smoke tests.
marta: If we accept mixed-SKU, document the acceptance and inform customers. Legal will draft a short consent clause for exceptions.
alexa: Action items: @sam push supplier for written early-release + airfreight firm ETA. @ben inventory exact pairing constraints on PulseLedger's deployment (firmware/driver). @linh draft runbook for mixed-SKU validation and cross-region pull. @cara prepare a cautious customer message.
ben: Inventory: PulseLedger needs A100 80GB or compatible 80GB-class SKUs; we can tolerate MX-variant if firmware >= 2025.9. I'll confirm compatibility list in 2 hours.
sam: Supplier committed to check warehouse availability for airfreight 120 units; said will reply within 3 hours and propose surcharge. I asked them to include insurance and customs clearance timeline.
cara: Draft comms: "We identified a supplier shipping change. We're moving to a mitigation plan to keep your launch on track and will share follow-up by EOD. No action needed from you at this time." Want a quick legal review before sending.
marta: That wording is fine. Add one sentence about "we'll escalate if the supplier cannot meet the mitigation." Avoid specifics on credits.
linh: Ops estimate: cross-region + smoke tests -> 24h. Marketplace burst procurement -> 6h to spin up creds + 4h to allocate. If supplier airfreights, we can integrate by 12h after dock.
ben: Best-case mix: supplier airfreight 120 + free 60 internal + marketplace 20 = 200 — covers PulseLedger 120 and leaves some buffer.
alexa: Good. Keep this thread updated with manifests and carrier docs. I'll hold customer outreach until we have written supplier confirmation or a concrete ops plan.
(orion-bot): Update: supplier confirmed 80-unit early release (mixed-SKU) ETA 2026-06-20. Airfreight still pending.
sam: Confirmed receipt of 80 units commitment. Still pushing for 120 airfreight. Negotiating surcharge offset.
cara: With 80 early units + 60 internal we reach PulseLedger's need. I'll prep the demo support checklist and notify product.
ben: Final inventory check: freed 60 internal (confirmed), 80 early release (confirmed), marketplace 0 so far. Ops says we can avoid marketplace if airfreight commits 40 more.
alexa: Closing loop for now — priority is to avoid SLA triggers and keep customers in the loop. Postmortem once shipments stabilize.
ben: (6h later) supplier confirmed airfreight for additional 40 units; customs ETA 2026-06-19 22:00 UTC. All combined sources cover PulseLedger. Closing thread.
